blocks.text: Fernbud is the compact continuation of tending a living thing in a made vessel. Its cradle and folded frond keep the gesture legible after the surrounding knowledge has simplified.
A coral ceramic seed cradle with a tiny folded deep teal fern and silver root threads.
One-shot use: The fern bends forward and releases a large shower of silver droplets over the cradle. The game performs the final fade.
15 silver. Infection severity −1; reaching zero clears the condition. Health +8; Cleanliness +3. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes.
Original PixelLab artwork and reviewed use animation, October 28, 2026. Image 4329200a-3f47-4fd7-af12-a9cfc694e5f9; animation 382d80e4-6351-4d2c-8ed2-a7fcefc4490a. Reduced motion holds a still.
